notes.title: Harambe, Hugh Mungus and many others in the newest update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Hope you're doing well! While you were enjoying the game the past week we were working hard on some additional characters that YOU have requested. That's right - we listen to the community and thanks to that today we can welcome Harambe, Hugh Mungus and others to the Intensive Exposure family!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26068852/b093d7314899c4cd8d2ff1e9785c7fc8ed3870f7.png

We have also fixed several bugs that you have reported to us and that includes the most notorious one - not getting achievements for unlocking skins. You will receive all your missing achievements upon entering the game after you update it.

So don't waste more time and go play the game now! #DicksOutForHarambe

Cheers,
Intensive Exposure Team
